metadata.notes: Omnidirectional Soft Sleeve Actuator (4-chamber bellows). Full device has 4 independent pressure channels (~3 independent DOF). This record describes one actuation mode; see also ossa_* siblings. Rest length 120 mm from the source paper (added 9 Jul 2026). Mode: selective chamber pressurization for bending (0-130 kPa). Paper reports 18 N bending force and 45 deg bend angle. blocked_force_N left null because the 18 N is a transverse/bending force, not the axial force the v0.1 scalar describes. free_stroke_m left null: converting the 45 deg bend to a tip displacement would require a constant-curvature assumption on top of the digitized endpoints -- one estimate too many.

input.energy_convention: mechanical work delivered at the input port (J)
